search_text: published ZDI-11-326 ZDI-CAN-1222 HP Data Protector Notebook Extension Policy Server LogClientInstallation Remote SQL Injection Vulnerabilty 2011-11-07 CVE-2011-3156 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2011-3156 9.0 AV:N/AC:L/Au:N/C:P/I:P/A:C ['Hewlett-Packard'] ['Data Protector'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of HP Data Protector Notebook Extension. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The flaw exists within the dpnepolicyservice component which exposes a DPNECentral Web Service on TCP port 80. This service contains a method LogClientInstallation which does not properly validate or sanitize the userid field of a user supplied request. This value is later used when constructing a query to fulfill the provided request. A remote attacker can exploit this vulnerability to execute arbitrary queries under the context of the service. Hewlett-Packard has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: https://h20566.www2.hp.com/portal/site/hpsc/public/kb/docDisplay/?docId=emr_na-c03058866 ['2011-06-03 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2011-11-07 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Andrea Micalizzi aka rgod https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-11-326/
